environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) running as the 'app' user with read/write access to /tmp/uploads and the application directory. The process runs with standard filesystem permissions, no containerization, no chroot. The /tmp directory is on the root filesystem alongside /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, and application secrets in /opt/app/.env. Symlinks are followable by default.
